tools.name: crypto-payments_stablecoin-payment-reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile caller-supplied stablecoin payment records against invoices. Compares amounts, token, recipient, and chain ID, and reports underpayments, overpayments, duplicate transaction hashes, and payments that are not linked to an invoice. reconciliation_status is matched, underpaid, overpaid, dupli

tools.name: crypto-payments_invoice-match-score
tools.description: Match caller-supplied payments to invoice amounts, due dates, and fee rates in basis points. Accuracy gives 60 points to the amount, 20 to paying on time, and 20 to the fee. The discrepancy is the invoice total minus the linked payments. No chain is queried. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/crypto-pay
